references.text: Beth-arabah is also mentioned here as a city in the border region of Judah, indicating that the town was located in the boundary area between Judah and Benjamin.
Beth-arabah is also listed among the cities given to Judah in the wilderness.
Bethel is mentioned here as the place where Jacob had his dream and named the place Bethel, which means 'house of God'.
Abraham pitched his tent near Bethel and built an altar there for the Lord.
Bethel is mentioned in connection with the spies who were sent out from Jericho.
The house of Joseph went up against Bethel and captured the city.
Bethel is mentioned as part of the border of the tribe of Joseph.
